holdout_allocation: five deterministic SHA256-based folds of island codes; training and test have no shared island endpoints; cross-fold pairs excluded from each fold
inferential_limit: All improvements are relative to source-same baseline including geodesic distance, TDWG botanical Level1 equality, latitude gap and accepted species richness margins.
The G model adds undirected GSHHG shortest-water route geometry, not NOAA current direction, physical seed drift or island-specific propagule viability.
The P model adds a contemporary WPI registered-port count product, not actual shipping OD.
Only 7 independent 2020 AIS source-matched original island pairs were observed; these cannot support global shipping inference.
Five heldout hashed island groups and fixed botanical source are not five independent natural experiments; intervals across five folds are descriptive.
Strict five-fold heldout both island endpoints improvements in G had uncertainty intervals spanning 0 for native and alien respectively; do not call confirmatory evidence.
Do not claim sea current preferentially predicts native or ships introduced flora; G improves both nominally and WPI P independently improves neither.
WCVP island marginal species richness comes from the same contemporary source in hold-out predictor data, not a prospective unseen island flora.
